topic: Weekly recap: block time, difficulty and efficiency
hook: Three Bitcoin mining ideas worth remembering this week.

scenes.narration: Bitcoin aims for a block roughly every ten minutes.
Every 2,016 blocks, difficulty resets to keep that pace.
Lower watts per terahash means less electricity for the same hashrate.

cta: Want to explore how digital Bitcoin mining works? Check the link on my channel page.
title: Weekly Bitcoin Mining Recap: 3 Ideas to Remember
description_body: A quick recap of block time, the difficulty adjustment and mining efficiency.
